svg.title: A water molecule on a regular real-space grid
svg.desc: An unchanged public-domain water molecule illustration sits in an original regular three-dimensional Cartesian grid. A pale teal envelope is a qualitative electron-density concept, not calculated data or orbital phase.
svg.metadata: {"description": "Original conceptual real-space Kohn–Sham DFT illustration; no quantitative calculation is represented.", "molecule_source": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Water-3D-balls.png", "molecule_image_url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b4/Water-3D-balls.png", "creator": "Benjah-bmm27 (Ben Mills)", "license": "Public domain, released by creator (PD-user)", "chemical_reference": "https://cccbdb.nist.gov/expgeom2x.asp?casno=7732185", "molecule_integrity": "Exact original PNG bytes, uniformly scaled and translated. No atom, bond, color, bond angle or internal pixel is edited.", "density": "Single-hue positive qualitative envelope only; not an orbital, phase plot, spin density, difference density, or computed water density.", "grid": "Orthographic isometric projection of an equally spaced Cartesian 6×6×2 cell box; all projected basis-vector lengths are 60.", "grid_reference": "https://www.octopus-code.org/documentation/main/developers/code_documentation/grids/", "density_reference": "https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/E01986"}
